question: What is the meaning of products deconstructability features in relation to sustainability features?
description:
Deconstructability features in products refer to the ease with which building components can be dismantled and reused, contributing to sustainability by promoting circularity and reducing waste. <|ENDINPUT>

Information requirements concerning repairability and durability play a key role in enabling consumers to engage in 
sustainable consumption. This Regulation should enable the establishment of repairability or durability scores for 
products where such scores are deemed appropriate for the purpose of providing environmental benefits and clearer 
information for consumers. In order to allow consumers to effectively assess and compare products, it is important 
that the format, content and display of such repairability and durability scores include easy-to-understand language 
and pictograms and that the repairability score be based on a harmonised methodology specified for the product or 
product group and which aggregates parameters, such as the availability and price of spare parts, the ease of 
disassembly and the availability of tools, into a single score.
